source_title: Samsung Galaxy Fit4 leaks, key features revealed
source_excerpt:
Last week we got our first look at the upcoming Samsung Galaxy Fit4 and we now have some specs to go with the images. Thanks to an APK teardown of the Galaxy Fit4 Manager companion app shared by SammyGuru we now have most of the wearable’s key specs.
For the most part, it appears to be very similar to 2024’s Galaxy Fit3 with similar-looking dimensions. According to a bunch of leaked watch faces, Fit4 will feature a 258 x 428px display, which would make the new model’s display slightly taller than the Fit3’s 256 x 402px panel.
Galaxy Fit4 watch faces (source: SammyGuru)
The new model will be able to have up to 12 tiles at a time, allowing it to display more information.
Galaxy Fit 4 tiles (source: SammyGuru)
Based on the watch face colors, the source believes we’ll see the Fit4 in Black, Silver, and Light Green color casings.
At its core, Fit4 will support all of the health and activity tracking from its predecessor, including step count, active calories, heart rate monitoring with alerts for high and low heart rate readings, as well as blood oxygen saturation and stress tracking. There’s no information for a GPS receiver, which likely implies it won’t be present.
The app does confirm on-device sleep tracking with sleep stages, sleep scores and a sleep coaching option, which becomes available after 7 days of wearing the watch. There’s no information as to when the Galaxy Fit4 will launch, but according to previous rumors, it should be priced under $100.
